newsitem.title: USA: Kysor completes sale to Kuhlman.
newsitem.headline: Kysor completes sale to Kuhlman.

text.p: Scotsman Industries Inc and Kysor Industrial Corp said Monday Kysor has completed the sale of substantially all of the assets of its Transportation Products Group to a subsidiary of Kuhlman Corp.

Earlier today, Scotsman and Kysor had announced that a subsidiary of Scotsman has accepted about 94 percent of Kysor stock under a tender off for all outstanding shares of common and preferred stock at $43 per share.
In a February 3 news release, Kysor said it agreed to sell its Transportation Products Group to Kuhlman form $86 million in cash and the assumption of the liabilities of the unit.
